## Open Questions
- TO CONFIRM: exact article-view route path after create (assumed `/article/<slug>`) — dev/BA.
- TO CONFIRM: whether editing an article's title changes its slug — dev/BA.
- TO CONFIRM: exact denial UX for a non-owner reaching `/editor/[slug]` (redirect vs. forbidden message) — dev/BA.
- TO CONFIRM: exact location of the Delete Article control (article view vs. editor; story text says "from the editor") — dev/BA.
- TO CONFIRM: unauthenticated `/editor` redirect target and whether a `?redirect=` return param is set — dev/BA.
- TO CONFIRM: nonexistent-profile UX (Next.js `notFound()` vs. custom message) — dev/BA.
- TO CONFIRM: Next.js cache/revalidation behaviour on create/edit/delete for feed & profile consistency — dev/BA.
- TO CONFIRM: self-profile affordance (Edit Profile Settings vs. hidden follow button) — dev/BA.
- TO CONFIRM: whether the article body is rendered as sanitized Markdown or plain text — dev/BA (affects TC-SEC-06).
- TO CONFIRM: documented field length limits for title/body/tags — dev/BA (affects TC-SEC-07).
- TO CONFIRM: session cookie name for the session-removal replay in TC-SEC-02 — dev/BA.
- TO CONFIRM: whether the profile tabs are an ARIA `tablist` pattern or plain nav links — dev/BA (affects TC-A11Y-03).
- TO CONFIRM: editor field labels/placeholders and whether real `<label>` associations exist — dev/BA (affects TC-A11Y-02).
- TO CONFIRM: editor validation-error presentation mechanism (inline vs. summary, `aria-live`) — dev/BA (affects TC-A11Y-07).
